User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the Arogya CRM, including their profile information, assigned role, and associated teamspaces. User authentication is handled externally by Firebase Auth.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for login and communication.

role.description: The user's assigned role (e.g., 'admin', 'sales_executive'). This determines access permissions and UI features.

teamspaceIds.description: References to Teamspace entities that this user is a member of. (Relationship: User N:N Teamspace)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was last updated.

Teamspace.title: Teamspace
Teamspace.description: Represents an isolated workspace for a team within Arogya CRM, designed to segregate data and modules for different functional teams.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Teamspace entity.

name.description: The name of the teamspace (e.g., 'Sales Teamspace', 'Marketing Teamspace').

description.description: A brief description of the teamspace's purpose and scope.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who created and typically administers this teamspace. (Relationship: User 1:N Teamspace)

memberIds.description: References to Users who are members of this teamspace, granting them access to its data and modules. (Relationship: Teamspace N:N User)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the teamspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the teamspace was last updated.

Lead.title: Lead
Lead.description: Represents a potential customer or prospect who has shown interest in Arogya Bio's products, requiring qualification and nurturing through the sales process.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Lead entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this lead belongs to, ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Lead)

fullName.description: The full name of the lead.

phone.description: The phone number of the lead.

email.description: The email address of the lead.

productAsked.description: The specific product or category of products the lead has inquired about.

source.description: The source from which the lead was acquired (e.g., 'Website', 'Referral').

status.description: The current status of the lead in the sales process (e.g., 'New', 'Contacted', 'Qualified', 'Unqualified').

leadScore.description: A numerical score indicating the lead's potential or likelihood to convert, calculated by the AI lead scoring system.

assignedToIds.description: References to Users (sales executives) currently assigned to nurture this lead. (Relationship: User N:N Lead)

attributionFields.description: JSON string containing attribution details, such as Google Ads campaign IDs or other marketing metadata, for tracking lead origins.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the lead record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the lead record was last updated.

Contact.title: Contact
Contact.description: Represents a person with whom Arogya CRM has an established relationship, typically converted from a lead or created directly as a customer or partner.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Contact entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this contact belongs to, ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Contact)

firstName.description: The first name of the contact.

lastName.description: The last name of the contact.

email.description: The primary email address of the contact.

phone.description: The primary phone number of the contact.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who owns this contact record. (Relationship: User 1:N Contact)

leadId.description: Optional reference to the original Lead if this contact was converted from a lead, for historical tracking. (Relationship: Lead 1:1 Contact)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the contact record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the contact record was last updated.

Deal.title: Deal
Deal.description: Represents a sales opportunity, tracking its progress through various stages in the sales pipeline.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Deal entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this deal belongs to, ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Deal)

name.description: The name or subject of the sales deal.

amount.description: The estimated or actual monetary value of the deal.

stage.description: The current stage of the deal in the sales pipeline (e.g., 'New', 'Contacted', 'Qualified', 'Demo', 'Negotiation', 'Won', 'Lost').

closeDate.description: The estimated or actual closing date of the deal.

contactId.description: Reference to the primary Contact associated with this deal. (Relationship: Contact 1:N Deal)

ownerId.description: Reference to the User (sales executive) responsible for managing this deal. (Relationship: User 1:N Deal)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the deal record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the deal record was last updated.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a specific action or item of work that needs to be completed, often related to other CRM entities.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Task entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this task belongs to, ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Task)

title.description: A concise title or summary for the task.

description.description: Detailed description of the task, including instructions or context.

dueDate.description: The date and time by which the task is expected to be completed.

status.description: The current status of the task (e.g., 'Pending', 'Completed', 'In Progress', 'Overdue').

priority.description: The importance or urgency level of the task (e.g., 'Low', 'Medium', 'High').

assignedToId.description: Reference to the User who is responsible for completing this task. (Relationship: User 1:N Task)

relatedToEntityType.description: The type of entity this task is related to (e.g., 'Lead', 'Contact', 'Deal').

relatedToEntityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity this task is related to.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the task was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the task was last updated.

Meeting.title: Meeting
Meeting.description: Represents a scheduled meeting, internal or external, with associated participants and related CRM entities.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Meeting entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this meeting belongs to, ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Meeting)

title.description: The subject or title of the meeting.

description.description: A detailed description or agenda for the meeting.

startTime.description: The scheduled start date and time of the meeting.

endTime.description: The scheduled end date and time of the meeting.

location.description: The physical or virtual location where the meeting will take place (e.g., 'Zoom Link', 'Conference Room A').

organizerId.description: Reference to the User who organized this meeting. (Relationship: User 1:N Meeting)

attendeeIds.description: References to Users or Contacts attending this meeting. (Relationship: Meeting N:N User/Contact)

relatedToEntityType.description: The type of entity this meeting is primarily related to (e.g., 'Lead', 'Contact', 'Deal').

relatedToEntityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity this meeting is related to.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the meeting was scheduled.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the meeting details were last updated.

Call.title: Call
Call.description: Represents a logged phone call activity with a lead or contact, including details about the conversation and outcome.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Call entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this call belongs to, ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Call)

subject.description: The subject or main purpose of the phone call.

notes.description: Detailed notes or a summary of the call discussion and outcomes.

callDate.description: The date and time the call occurred.

callDurationMinutes.description: The duration of the call in minutes.

status.description: The outcome or status of the call (e.g., 'Completed', 'No Answer', 'Voicemail', 'Busy').

callerId.description: Reference to the User who made or received the call. (Relationship: User 1:N Call)

relatedToEntityType.description: The type of entity this call is related to (e.g., 'Lead', 'Contact', 'Deal').

relatedToEntityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity this call is related to.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the call log was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the call log was last updated.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Represents a document or file stored in the CRM, often linked to other entities for contextual access.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Document entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this document belongs to, ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Document)

name.description: The name or title of the document.

fileUrl.description: The URL to the actual file stored in Firebase Storage.

fileType.description: The MIME type or extension of the file (e.g., 'application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'text/plain').

fileSizeKB.description: The size of the file in kilobytes (KB).

uploadedById.description: Reference to the User who uploaded this document. (Relationship: User 1:N Document)

relatedToEntityType.description: The type of entity this document is primarily related to (e.g., 'Lead', 'Contact', 'Deal', 'Product').

relatedToEntityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity this document is related to.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the document was uploaded.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the document metadata was last updated.

Campaign.title: Campaign
Campaign.description: Represents a marketing campaign, used to track efforts, budget, and results over a defined period.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Campaign entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this campaign belongs to, ensuring data isolation (e.g., 'Marketing Teamspace'). (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Campaign)

name.description: The name of the marketing campaign.

type.description: The type of campaign (e.g., 'Email Marketing', 'Social Media Ad', 'Event Promotion').

status.description: The current status of the campaign (e.g., 'Planned', 'Active', 'Completed', 'Paused', 'Cancelled').

startDate.description: The scheduled start date of the campaign.

endDate.description: The scheduled end date of the campaign.

budget.description: The allocated monetary budget for the campaign.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User (marketer) responsible for this campaign. (Relationship: User 1:N Campaign)

description.description: A detailed description of the campaign objectives, target audience, and strategy.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the campaign record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the campaign record was last updated.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents an Ayurvedic wellness supplement product offered by Arogya Bio, including its catalog details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

name.description: The common name of the product.

description.description: A detailed description of the product, including its benefits, ingredients, and usage.

sku.description: The Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) for the product, a unique identifier for inventory management.

category.description: The category the product belongs to (e.g., 'Immunity Boosters', 'Digestive Health', 'Herbal Teas').

price.description: The retail price of the product.

stock.description: The current inventory level of the product.

imageUrl.description: URL to the main product image stored in Firebase Storage.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the product was first added to the catalog.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the product information was last updated.

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: A formal offer for products or services sent to a potential customer, detailing proposed items and pricing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Quote entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this quote belongs to, ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Quote)

name.description: The name or subject of the quote (e.g., 'Quote for Corporate Wellness Package').

contactId.description: Reference to the primary Contact associated with this quote. (Relationship: Contact 1:N Quote)

validUntil.description: The date and time until which the quote remains valid.

status.description: The current status of the quote (e.g., 'Draft', 'Sent', 'Accepted', 'Rejected', 'Expired').

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the quote, including all line items, taxes, and discounts.

lineItems.description: An array of line items included in the quote.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User (sales executive) who created this quote. (Relationship: User 1:N Quote)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the quote was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the quote was last updated.

SalesOrder.title: SalesOrder
SalesOrder.description: A confirmed order placed by a customer, typically generated from an accepted quote, initiating the fulfillment process.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SalesOrder entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this sales order belongs to, ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N SalesOrder)

orderNumber.description: A unique identifier or reference number for the sales order.

contactId.description: Reference to the primary Contact associated with this order. (Relationship: Contact 1:N SalesOrder)

orderDate.description: The date and time the sales order was placed.

status.description: The current fulfillment status of the sales order (e.g., 'Pending', 'Processing', 'Shipped', 'Completed', 'Cancelled').

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the sales order, including all line items, taxes, and shipping.

lineItems.description: An array of line items included in the sales order.

quoteId.description: Optional reference to the Quote from which this sales order was generated. (Relationship: Quote 1:1 SalesOrder)

ownerId.description: Reference to the User (sales executive) responsible for this sales order. (Relationship: User 1:N SalesOrder)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the sales order was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the sales order was last updated.

PurchaseOrder.title: PurchaseOrder
PurchaseOrder.description: An order placed by Arogya Bio to a supplier for acquiring products, raw materials, or other goods/services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PurchaseOrder entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this purchase order belongs to (e.g., 'Operations Teamspace'), ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N PurchaseOrder)

orderNumber.description: A unique identifier or reference number for the purchase order.

supplierName.description: The name of the supplier from whom products or services are being purchased.

orderDate.description: The date and time the purchase order was placed.

expectedDeliveryDate.description: The anticipated date of delivery for the ordered items.

status.description: The current status of the purchase order (e.g., 'Pending', 'Ordered', 'Received', 'Cancelled').

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the purchase order.

lineItems.description: An array of line items included in the purchase order.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who created this purchase order. (Relationship: User 1:N PurchaseOrder)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the purchase order was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the purchase order was last updated.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: A bill issued to a customer for products or services provided, typically generated from a sales order.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Invoice entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this invoice belongs to, ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Invoice)

salesOrderId.description: Reference to the SalesOrder this invoice is generated from. (Relationship: SalesOrder 1:1 Invoice)

invoiceDate.description: The date the invoice was issued.

dueDate.description: The date by which the invoice payment is due.

status.description: The payment status of the invoice (e.g., 'Draft', 'Sent', 'Paid', 'Partially Paid', 'Overdue', 'Voided').

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the invoice, including all line items, taxes, and shipping.

paidAmount.description: The total amount that has been paid towards this invoice.

lineItems.description: An array of line items included in the invoice.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who generated this invoice. (Relationship: User 1:N Invoice)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the invoice was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the invoice was last updated.

Ticket.title: Ticket
Ticket.description: Represents a customer support ticket, used to track and manage customer inquiries or issues from inception to resolution.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Ticket entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this ticket belongs to (e.g., 'Support Teamspace'), ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Ticket)

subject.description: A concise subject line that summarizes the customer's support request.

description.description: Detailed description of the customer's issue or inquiry.

status.description: The current status of the ticket (e.g., 'Open', 'In Progress', 'Awaiting Customer', 'Resolved', 'Closed').

priority.description: The urgency level of the ticket (e.g., 'Low', 'Medium', 'High', 'Urgent').

contactId.description: Reference to the Contact who raised this support ticket. (Relationship: Contact 1:N Ticket)

assignedToId.description: Reference to the User (support agent) assigned to handle this ticket. (Relationship: User 1:N Ticket)

category.description: The category of the ticket (e.g., 'Technical Support', 'Billing Inquiry', 'Product Information', 'Complaint').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the ticket was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the ticket was last updated.

Refund.title: Refund
Refund.description: Tracks customer refund requests, detailing the reason, amount, and processing status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Refund entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this refund request belongs to (e.g., 'Support Teamspace'), ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Refund)

salesOrderId.description: Reference to the SalesOrder for which the refund is requested. (Relationship: SalesOrder 1:N Refund)

reason.description: The reason provided by the customer or internal team for the refund request.

amount.description: The monetary amount requested for refund.

status.description: The current status of the refund request (e.g., 'Pending', 'Approved', 'Rejected', 'Processed', 'Cancelled').

requestedById.description: Reference to the User or Contact who initiated the refund request. (Relationship: User/Contact 1:N Refund)

processedById.description: Reference to the User (support agent or operations staff) who processed the refund. (Relationship: User 1:N Refund)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the refund request was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the refund request was last updated.

Complaint.title: Complaint
Complaint.description: Records and manages customer complaints, allowing for detailed tracking, assignment, and resolution processes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Complaint entity.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace this complaint belongs to (e.g., 'Support Teamspace'), ensuring data isolation. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N Complaint)

subject.description: A concise subject line for the customer complaint.

description.description: Detailed description of the customer's complaint, including all relevant context.

status.description: The current status of the complaint (e.g., 'Received', 'Investigating', 'Action Taken', 'Resolved', 'Closed').

contactId.description: Reference to the Contact who filed this complaint. (Relationship: Contact 1:N Complaint)

assignedToId.description: Reference to the User (support agent) assigned to handle this complaint. (Relationship: User 1:N Complaint)

severity.description: The severity level of the complaint (e.g., 'Minor', 'Moderate', 'Major', 'Critical').

relatedToEntityType.description: Optional: The type of entity this complaint is related to (e.g., 'SalesOrder', 'Product', 'Service').

relatedToEntityId.description: Optional: The unique identifier of the related entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the complaint was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the complaint was last updated.

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Records significant actions and changes within the CRM for audit trails, historical tracking, and activity timelines on specific entities.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ActivityLog entry.

teamspaceId.description: Reference to the Teamspace where the activity occurred. (Relationship: Teamspace 1:N ActivityLog)

userId.description: Reference to the User who performed the action. (Relationship: User 1:N ActivityLog)

action.description: A concise description of the action performed (e.g., 'Lead Created', 'Deal Stage Changed', 'Product Updated').

entityType.description: The type of CRM entity that was affected by this action (e.g., 'Lead', 'Deal', 'Product', 'User').

entityId.description: The unique identifier of the specific entity instance that was affected by the action.

oldValue.description: Optional: A JSON string representing the state of the entity's relevant fields before the action was performed.

newValue.description: Optional: A JSON string representing the state of the entity's relevant fields after the action was performed.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the action was recorded.

ipAddress.description: The IP address from which the action originated, for security auditing purposes.

userAgent.description: The user agent string of the client performing the action, for security auditing purposes.

definition.description: Represents an isolated workspace for a team.
Records significant actions for audit trails.
